title: NFL and Fox reach agreement to show games on Mexican TV platforms

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL and Fox reach agreement to show games on Mexican TV platforms
sources.description: Despite talk that the NFL and Fox may be butting heads regarding the future of the American television landscape, the two big businesses have agreed to work together in Mexico.
